def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    # find frame color: color forming outer rect of the object (most common nonzero)
    colors=Counter(c for r in inp for c in r)
    bg=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg=[c for c in colors if c!=bg]
    frame=max(nonbg,key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in inp))
    inn=[c for c in nonbg if c!=frame][0]
    # frame bbox

def load():

def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    colors={c:sum(r.count(c) for r in inp) for c in set(v for r in inp for v in r)}
    frame=max((c for c in colors if c!=0), key=lambda c:colors[c])
    inn=[c for c in colors if c!=frame and c!=0][0]
    fr=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==frame]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,_ in fr),max(i for i,_ in fr)
    c0,c1=min(j for _,j in fr),max(j for _,j in fr)
    # inner extent
    ir=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==inn]
    ih=r1-r0; iw=c1-c0
    # ring thickness: floor(inner_side/2)+1 (fits all 4 demos)
    k=(max(len({i for i,_ in ir}), len({j for _,j in ir}))-1)//2 + 1
    out=[[inp[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    for i in range(max(0,r0-k),min(H,r1+k+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,c0-k),min(W,c1+k+1)):
            if not(r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1):
                out[i][j]=inn
    return out
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    print(n, solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
